Description: This old cart once carried harvests from the fields, now it only gathers dust by the wall.
The great tree stands tall, offering shade to tired workers and whispering leaves to the wind.
Chopping wood here is endless work — the castle always hungers for more firewood.
The sound of the axe echoes across the yard, a rhythm older than the castle itself.
Some say this tree has witnessed every generation of guards who passed through these gates.
Even in times of war, the woodpile grew steadily — fire keeps fear at bay.
